items.question: What is the difference between the Credits Package and the subscription plans?
items.answer: The Credits Package is a one-time purchase valid for 1 year. Subscription plans (Starter Monthly / Premium Annually) auto-renew and give you fresh credits every billing cycle at a lower per-credit rate.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
items.answer: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time. You will continue to have access to your credits until the end of the current billing period.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: New accounts receive a small number of free credits to try the platform. No credit card is required to explore the free tier.

items.question: What payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) via our secure payment processor.

items.question: Do unused credits roll over?
items.answer: Credits from the one-time package are valid for 1 year from purchase. Monthly subscription credits reset each billing cycle; unused credits do not roll over.

items.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
items.answer: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your subscription at any time from the billing settings page. Changes take effect at the start of the next billing cycle.
